name: Spainwave
summary: Unlike classic Vaporwave, which primarily draws from 1980s-90s American and Japanese consumer culture, Spainwave sources its material from a broad spectrum of Spanish history, from the Spanish Golden Age to the present day.
description: Unlike classic Vaporwave, which primarily draws from 1980s-90s American and Japanese consumer culture, Spainwave sources its material from a broad spectrum of Spanish history, from the Spanish Golden Age to the present day.
